chronology.no_rescue: No tuning, new family, threshold change or grid extension after development results are seen.
chronology.refit: 2024 weeks 1-18 with frozen hyperparameters, only after a selection pass
chronology.validation: 2025 weeks 1-18, opened ONLY if at least one family survives development on a head

coherence_gate.team_volume: frozen Phase1B team projection only; team volume is never modified here

commit_order: sources + audit + baseline + implementation + tests + workflow

comparators.C1_phase1d: frozen Phase1D allocation (nfl_v2_phase1d_role_allocation.allocation with the selected config) for each head
comparators.C2_recent3_share: Phase1D's transparent prior-3 team share (players with >= 2 games)

C3_competent_human.definition: raw_i = m3_i*(1 + 0.5*clip(snap_trend_i, -0.3, 0.3)) + 0.5*max(0, persist_i); persist_i = mean(last two shares) - mean(earlier up to six shares) when BOTH of the last two shares exceed that earlier mean by >= 0.03, else 0; m3_i = prior-3 team mean share; snap_trend_i = last-game offense snap pct - mean of the previous up to two (0 when snaps are missing); teammate vacancy is handled by normalizing raw scores over the target-week ACTIVE eligible roster only; players without history receive 0.15 * Phase1D position cold-start share; shares normalize to 1.

comparators.strongest_comparator: per head and period, the comparator (C1, C2 or C3) with the lowest oracle player-opportunity MAE on that period's primary rows

downstream_phase1e: ONLY if a head qualifies independently on 2024 and 2025: plug its workload into frozen efficiency (no efficiency change); report receptions/receiving yards/rushing yards; no promotion from downstream stats alone, no cancellation credit. Otherwise NOT_RUN.
family_survival: a family survives development on a head iff it meets practical_thresholds against Phase1D and the human baseline on 2024 W9-18 primary rows; the head passes development if at least one family (or the survivor combination) survives
forbidden: target-game snaps, starter states or participation as features
injury reports as features (no original publication timestamps)
boosted trees or neural networks (only if a simple routed signal first proves value)
any yard or efficiency model change
production, frontend, scheduler, grading, calibration, frozen forecasts, other sports

A_receiving.team_volume_source: frozen Phase1B team-opportunity formula with outcomes.rec_yds.selected_opportunity_config (the source Phase1D/Phase1E used)

heads.independence: the two heads are fitted, selected and judged separately; one architecture is not forced on both

history_rule: A prior player-game is usable iff it is strictly earlier by (season, week) for the same team (Phase1D contract). Prior-week roster/team state only; no target-game outcomes.

locked_states_not_reopened.phase1d_allocators: SURVIVED (frozen comparator; not reopened or retuned)

also: catastrophic workload miss rate (>6 targets / >10 carries)
concentration error = |predicted - actual HHI| over eval team-weeks
metrics.bootstrap: 2,000 seeded (20261201) moving 2-consecutive-week blocks of complete team-weeks, paired by player-game
metrics.player_opportunity: PRIMARY = oracle player opportunity = predicted share x ACTUAL team opportunity (isolates the role); SECONDARY = coupled = predicted share x frozen Phase1B team projection

model_class.form: predicted share_i = max(0, phase1d_share_i + delta_i), renormalized over the active eligible roster; delta_i is a ridge regression (closed form, standardized features, unpenalized intercept) on the family's features fitted on 2024 W1-8 rows
model_class.selection_rule: per family and head, the lambda with the lowest oracle player-opportunity MAE on 2024 W9-18 primary rows

decompositions: actual team volume x predicted share (role error)
predicted team volume x actual share (team-volume error)
errors split by actual target-game snap share bucket (availability)
errors in games where an expected teammate (prior-3 share >= 0.10) has no target-game stat row (late absence)
oracle_forensics.status: POSTGAME DESCRIPTIVE ONLY; never used for fitting, selection or promotion

population.expanded_secondary: reported separately, not a gate: prior-3 average >= 1.5 targets / >= 2.5 carries with >= 2 prior games
population.fit_rows: 2024 W1-8 active eligible roster players with >= 1 prior game for the team; target = actual share (0 when no stat row) minus the frozen Phase1D predicted share; players without history keep the Phase1D share
population.never: a candidate cannot change its own evaluation rows
population.primary: EXACTLY the frozen Phase1D fixed meaningful rows for the head: prior-3-game team average of the opportunity >= Phase1D min_pred_opp (3.0 targets / 5.0 carries) with >= 2 prior games, the player is on the target-week active eligible roster (Phase1D fail-closed rule). Defined before and independently of any candidate.

practical_thresholds.role_change_slices: the CHANGE_FLAGGED_UNION slice must improve by >= 5% relative versus the strongest comparator on that slice, and the STABLE_ROLE slice must not worsen by more than 2% relative
practical_thresholds.rule_vs_each_comparator: gain >= max(absolute, 5% of the comparator MAE) vs BOTH the strongest of {C1 Phase1D, C3 human} and each individually, AND paired block-bootstrap upper-95 of (candidate - comparator) < 0, AND catastrophic miss rate (>6 targets / >10 carries) not more than 0.005 above the comparator, AND coherence gate passes
practical_thresholds.tiny_wins: A gain below the absolute threshold never qualifies.

pregame_slice_labels.CHANGE_FLAGGED_UNION: INCREASING_ROLE or DECREASING_ROLE or TEAMMATE_VACANCY or ROOKIE_DEVELOPMENT
pregame_slice_labels.COMMITTEE: team's prior-3 top-1 share within the position group < 0.25 (targets) / < 0.55 (carries)
pregame_slice_labels.HIGH_CONCENTRATION: team prior-3 HHI at or above the upper tercile of the 2024 W1-8 estimation team-weeks
pregame_slice_labels.LOW_CONCENTRATION: at or below the lower tercile (terciles computed on the estimation weeks and written to the lock)
pregame_slice_labels.TEAMMATE_VACANCY: prior-3-game average share of teammates absent from the target-week active eligible roster >= 0.10 (targets) / 0.15 (carries)

question: Can pregame role-change signals (recency acceleration, snap change, usage concentration, teammate vacancy, rookie trajectory, change-point detection, constrained role competition) predict RECEIVER TARGET and RB/ball-carrier CARRY opportunity materially better than frozen Phase1D and a frozen competent-human role baseline, while preserving coherent team share conservation?
receipts: every evaluated player-game in 2024 (W1-18 primary rows, flagged by period) for the best development family per head: player, team, opponent, position, eligible teammate set, prior/recent/long/short shares, snap and trend, vacancy indicators, concentration, rookie state, role-change score and direction, frozen team opportunity, predicted and actual share/opportunity, errors, family/model version, source hashes
reproducibility: Float means use explicit left-to-right accumulation (no sum() compensation differences across Python versions); inputs are digest-pinned; nothing reads a mutable upstream file.

role_change_definition.note: The threshold is fixed here, before validation; not every row may be called a role change.
role_change_definition.reference: team prior-3-game mean share of the player (>= 2 prior games)

scope: Player WORKLOAD only (target share/targets and carry share/carries). No yards, no efficiency, no team-volume change (Phase1N is rejected and not reused), no Monte Carlo, no sportsbook, no paid or new vendor data.

signal_families.A_recency_acceleration: last-game share minus EWMA(0.85) share; short(0.5)-minus-long EWMA; slope of the last up to 4 shares; persistence indicator (last two shares above the earlier mean by >= 0.02)
signal_families.B_snap_change: last-game offense snap pct; prior-3 snap mean; snap trend (last minus the mean of the previous up to two); consecutive high-snap games (>= 0.60); snap/opportunity divergence = snap pct - 2.0*share (fixed constant); missing indicator
signal_families.C_usage_concentration: team prior-3 top-1 share, top-2 share and HHI over the eligible group; the player's prior-3 rank indicators (1, 2); player share x team HHI
signal_families.D_teammate_vacancy: vacated prior-3 share of teammates absent from the active roster (total, same position, other position); proportional-absorption term = vacated total x own m3 / (sum of remaining m3); count of teammates whose last-game share fell to 0 from >= 0.10
signal_families.E_rookie_development: rookie flag (years_exp == 0); draft round bucket from draft_number (R1 <= 32, R2 <= 64, R3 <= 100, later, undrafted/unknown); prior career games; rookie x last-game acceleration; rookie x snap trend
signal_families.F_change_point: z = (mean(last two) - mean(earlier up to six)) / sqrt(sigma0^2 + variance(earlier)) with sigma0 = 0.04 (targets) / 0.08 (carries); one-sided CUSUM S_t = max(0, S_{t-1} + (x_t - mu_prior - 0.01)) over the last four games; thresholded persistent-jump flag (z >= 1.5 and both recent shares >= mu_prior + 0.02); new-regime term = flag x (mean(last two) - EWMA long)
signal_families.G_role_competition: sum of teammates' last-game accelerations in the same position group (excluding the player); teammate rise flag count; rank-weighted teammate acceleration; the constrained allocation is enforced by renormalizing predicted shares over the active eligible roster (sum = 1)
signal_families.H_survivor_combination: only families that each survive development on that head are combined; failed families are never added

sources.2026_w1_4: burned diagnostic only on the exact pinned bytes. The current 2026 release assets no longer match the Phase1H pins (stats_player_week_2026 and roster_weekly_2026 digests differ as observed 2026-10-06), so the diagnostic is NOT_RUN_PINNED_BYTES_UNAVAILABLE; it does not block a promotion verdict but a promotion cannot claim it. 2026 files are never opened.

excluded_sources.depth_charts: 2024 has no dt timestamps; 2025+ dt is a load time with unresolved reuse rights
excluded_sources.draft_metadata: only roster-file draft_number/years_exp/entry_year as WEAK priors
excluded_sources.routes_2026: unavailable; no route data is used or implied

sources.roster: roster_weekly_{2023,2024,2025}.csv (Phase1H manifest pins): player id, position, status, years_exp, draft_number, pfr_id, entry/rookie year

snap_counts.acceptance: family B needs >= 95% of skill-position snap rows (offense_pct > 0) mapped to a GSIS id on 2023-2024; otherwise family B is BLOCKED_DATA
snap_counts.acquired: 2026-10-06 (data acquisition only; no analysis before this protocol)
snap_counts.files: snap_counts_{2023,2024,2025}.csv from nflverse-data release snap_counts (public, CC-BY root license)
snap_counts.id_join: pfr_player_id -> gsis_id through the pinned roster pfr_id column (exact id join; no name matching); unmapped rows are counted and ignored
snap_counts.timing: completed prior games only; the target game's snaps never enter a feature

sources.week_status: Target-week roster status follows the existing Phase1D contract (T90 interpretation: game-day inactive/non-active roster states are known at T90; unknown/blank status is retained). Historical weekly rosters are final-week snapshots without original per-status receipts; this is an inherited, disclosed limitation, not a new assumption.

stages: --stage validate (refuses unless the lock passed; opens 2025 only then)

verdicts.PARTIAL_SIGNAL_NOT_PROMOTED: some family improves a comparator materially on one head or one period but the full standard is not met
verdicts.REJECTED_ROLE_CHANGE_REPLACEMENT: no family qualifies against Phase1D on any head in development
verdicts.SURVIVES_ROLE_CHANGE_REPLACEMENT: development pass AND untouched 2025 pass under the same thresholds (and the slice rule), coherence preserved, 2026 W1-4 diagnostic (when exact pinned bytes exist) not badly contradicting
verdicts.per_head: each head receives its own verdict; the overall verdict is the best head verdict with a note that heads are independent
